name: Tupac Shakur
description: Follow Tupac Shakur, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Duane Davis' attorney doesn't believe jury considered all evidence before Tupac murder conviction
changes.summary: Michael Sanft, Duane "Keefe D" Davis' defense attorney, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss his client's conviction for the 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur and shares his concerns about the jury's "preconceived notions.".

changes.title: Defense attorney believes jury had "preconceived notions" in Tupac trial
changes.summary: Duane "Keffe D" Davis was convicted of first-degree murder nearly 30 years after the drive-by shooting that killed Tupac Shakur.

changes.title: Jury convicts a man of first-degree murder for the 1996 killing of rap icon Tupac Shakur
changes.summary: A jury found Duane "Keffe D" Davis guilty of orchestrating the 1996 killing of rap icon Tupac Shakur, finally bringing a measure of resolution to a case that had gripped hip-hop fans for decades. (Image credit: Bizuayehu Tesfaye).

changes.title: Trial begins for man accused of orchestrating Tupac Shakur's killing
changes.summary: Duane "Keffe D" Davis has pleaded not guilty to one charge of murder. People who will testify include those who saw Shakur moments before he was shot, as well as people who were affiliated with rival record labels.

changes.title: Tupac Murder Trial Set to Begin, Nearly 30 Years After Shooting
changes.summary: The man accused of planning the murder of Tupac Shakur is set to stand trial as prosecutors look to prove Duane "Keefe D" Davis orchestrated the drive-by shooting that killed the hip-hop legend nearly 30 years ago. changes.title: Nearly 30 years after Tupac's death, the trial over his murder will finally begin
changes.summary: In 2023, police charged Duane Davis, also known as "Keefe D," with organizing Tupac Shakur's murder in 1996. Author Ben Westhoff discusses Davis' trial that begins Monday.
